releaseDialog.title: New environment
releaseDialog.intro: One submission creates the pieces that only make sense together: the component if you name a new one, the version, the environment, the domain that faces it and the endpoint we ask for its version.
releaseDialog.name: name
releaseDialog.probeToggle: ask the deployment for its version
releaseDialog.versionHint: Pick the component first: versions belong to one part, not to the product.
releaseDialog.probeHint: A read-only GET against the domain above. If the version it returns is not named yet, it is created inside this component — never duplicated.
releaseDialog.placeholder.name: backend
releaseDialog.error.component: Choose a component or name a new one.
releaseDialog.error.environment: An environment is required — DEV, PRE, PRO…
releaseDialog.error.version: Pick an existing version, name a new one, or let the endpoint read it.
releaseDialog.error.probeDomain: A probe needs a domain to ask. Choose or type one, or turn the probe off.
